output: Four minutes to recalculate a forecast across six thousand SKUs and thirty-two distribution points is a real problem, and it's a fair thing to worry about before committing. Very large models can slow down, and in our experience model design matters as much as the platform itself. During implementation we include a model design review so that the structure suits your volume, and before you sign, we can test performance on a sample of your own data. [PROOF] We can run a performance test on an anonymized sample of your largest model and share the results with you before any commitment on your side.
